_about: Only distinct options reach Krish's Pick a style press (Krish, 2026-11-04: "strengthen the weak styles before Friday"). `ve styles` (scripts/velib/styles.py) renders the house look and each shortlisted style on the same window, takes `frames` frames evenly spaced across each clip with ffmpeg, scales them to `width` px wide in greyscale and scores every pair by the mean absolute difference of their pixels (0 to 255). An option is offered only when it differs from the house look and from every other option by at least `threshold`; a look-alike is replaced by the next ranked style the renderer can draw, and with fewer than three distinct options it offers two and says so. `effects` names the devices each style's own effect touches, so a style whose effects touch no device in the window is left out and named before anything renders (apps/renderer/src/engine/engine.test.ts holds these lists equal to the renderer's devices/focus.ts).

tuned_on.window: Thursday 5 Nov (2026-11-05-thursday-no-spending, short cut, frames 140 to 320, scale 0.5, stand-in take)
tuned_on.renders: PR #381 clips, before the strong styles
tuned_on.why: dark-keynote reads clearly different by eye and riso-halftone visibly but subtly; the old living-ui looked the same as the house. 1.5 sits well under the weakest style he could tell apart (2.82) and nine times over the look-alike (0.17).
tuned_on.five_styles: 4 Nov 2026, frames 315 to 555 of the same short cut, scale 0.5, stand-in take: once given looks of their own, swiss-kinetic-type scored 7.2 against the house, vertical-captions 8.0, paper-cutout 10.7, line-boil 55.1 and hud-terminal 68.9, each 7 or more from every other style (they had scored 0.39 to 0.62 against the house when they differed only by timing)

typewriter.what: types text a character at a time

zoomToFocus.what: zooms to the line a device reports

halftone.what: lays a halftone on his take

inkDeep.what: lays ink_deep under a graphics-only beat

dark.what: lays ink_deep under every graphic ground, a SPLIT stage included, and inverts text cards

paper.what: lays a seeded paper stock under the graphics

hero.what: sets the beat's key phrase as hero type on its graphic ground

lead.what: makes his captions the main graphic

brackets.what: locks bracket corners onto the line a device reports

torn.what: cuts cards and logo tiles out with a torn edge and a soft shadow
